The [[Standard year/Legends|year]] '''4300 BBY''' was a period of [[Time/Legends|time]] in the [[Post-Manderon period|era]] following the [[Manderon Period]]. That year, the [[Miraluka/Legends|Miraluka]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Noab Hulis]] arrived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[H'ratth]] and spoke with [[Chamma]], a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] who had exiled himself after touching the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]]. Hulis was successful in convincing him to return to the light and end his exile.
